# Shipments

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 4 · Functional specifications

Parent page: [Functional specifications](section-4.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:64280539c51166b4 -->
Shipment requests are a separate entity from the device request lifecycle: a sender, recipient and package dimensions are recorded, an administrator approves or deletes the request, and known addresses are suggested to speed up entry. The workspace does not document the link between a shipment request and a device request; this is reported in section 8.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
